async def act(page):

    # After navigation, wait for the page to load

    await merge_requests_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    merge_request_link = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text=re.compile(r'octovisuals', re.IGNORECASE))

    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name=re.compile(r'Comment', re.IGNORECASE))
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
